rationale: DesignIR parsing no longer runs the Figma shadow sibling snap on a browser capture: when the IR's source adapter is browser-capture, a node that sits inside an absolute sibling's drop-shadow reach keeps the position Chromium measured instead of being lifted by the gap minus the shadow's y offset. Design-tool IR is unchanged. A new lens-calibration fixture (20-flex-gap-knob) lays out knob columns across gaps, dial sizes, box-sizing and shadow reach. Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
